4.text:
Data set X: 13, 15, 17, 20, 23, 24, 24, 25, 37
Data set Y: 13, 15, 17, 20, 23, 24, 24, 25, 32
Data set Y is created by replacing the number 37 in data set X with the number 32. Which of the following statements is true about the means and medians of data set X and data set Y?

choices.A: The mean of data set X is greater than the mean of data set Y, and the median of data set X equals the median of data set Y.
choices.B: The mean of data set X is greater than the mean of data set Y, and the median of data set X is greater than the median of data set Y.
choices.C: The mean of data set X equals the mean of data set Y, and the median of data set X equals the median of data set Y.
choices.D: The mean of data set X is less than the mean of data set Y, and the median of data set X is greater than the median of data set Y.

7.text: An entomologist placed an initial population of 20 Tenebrio molitor, a type of beetle, into a habitat and monitored the population over time. When the number of Tenebrio molitor in the habitat reached 180% of the initial population, the entomologist moved 75% of the Tenebrio molitor to a second habitat. How many Tenebrio molitor did the entomologist move to the second habitat at this time?
